ObjectStates.Name: Custom_Tile
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
scaleMultiplier=1.8
clickedTime=0
function onLoad(save_state)
    --self.interactable=false

    params = {
           click_function = "onClick",
           function_owner = self,
           label          = "",
           position       = {0, 0.05, 0.7},
           rotation       = {0, 0, 0},
           width          = 300,
           height         = 150,
           font_size      = 25,
           color          = {0.1, 0.1,0.1},
           tooltip        = "Meme me",
       }
       self.createButton(params)

end

function onClick(obj, color, alt_click)
    if(os.time()-clickedTime>3)then
        printToAll("Generating meme. Please Wait...", {1, 0.670, 0.121})
        clickedTime=os.time()
        scale=self.getScale().z/scaleMultiplier;
        rot=self.getRotation()
        selfPos=self.positionToWorld({0,2,-0.15})

        spawnParams = {
            type = "Custom_Tile",
            position          = selfPos,
            rotation          = rot,
            scale             = {scale,3,scale},
            sound             = false,
            snap_to_grid      = true,
            locked=false
        }
        WebRequest.get("https://meme-api.com/gimme", function(a) webRequestCallback(a) end)
        --makeMeme("https://memeshappen.com/media/created/2018/04/When-shes-the-queen--Of-your-double-wide-trailer-.jpg")
    else
        num = round(3-(os.time()-clickedTime),1)
        printToAll("Please Wait for "..num.." seconds", {0.827, 0.364, 0.352})
    end

end

function onRandomize(player_color)
    print("ok")
end

function webRequestCallback(webReturn)
    decoded = JSON.decode(webReturn.text)
    makeMeme(decoded['url'])
end

function makeMeme(url)
    if(string.sub(url,-4)=="jpeg" or string.sub(url,-4)==".jpg" or string.sub(url,-4)==".png" or string.sub(url,-4)=="webm" or string.sub(url,-4)==".mp4" or string.sub(url,-4)==".m4v" or string.sub(url,-4)==".mov" or string.sub(url,-4)=="rawt")then
        meme = spawnObject(spawnParams)
        meme.setCustomObject({image = url,thickness=0.01})
        meme.setLock(false)
        meme = meme.reload()
        printToAll("Your meme is ready.", {0.564, 0.862, 0.415})
    else
        WebRequest.get("https://meme-api.com/gimme", function(a) webRequestCallback(a) end)
    end
end

function round(num, numDecimalPlaces)
  local mult = 10^(numDecimalPlaces or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end
